description: This file defines the ICacheDataAdapter interface within the Orleans.Streams namespace, providing methods for transforming cached messages for stream delivery and retrieving sequence tokens.

classes.name: ICacheDataAdapter
classes.description: An interface for adapters that transform cached message data into formats suitable for stream processing, including methods to get batch containers and sequence tokens.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts a cached message into a batch container suitable for delivery.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stream sequence token associated with a cached message.
